title: Revenue Leak Lead Finder input
description: Find local businesses whose public booking, appointment, reservation, consultation, or contact links have an independently verified objective failure. Output is one qualified business per dataset item.

locations.title: Metro areas
locations.description: Choose one or more built-in metro bounding boxes. Add custom boxes below for other markets.

customBboxes.title: Custom bounding boxes
customBboxes.description: Optional extra markets. Bounding box format: south,west,north,east.

startUrls.title: Direct websites
startUrls.description: Optional websites to inspect in addition to discovered local businesses.

maxCandidates.title: Maximum candidate websites
maxCandidates.description: Hard cap on websites inspected. Higher values cost more compute.

maxResults.title: Maximum paid results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many verified revenue-leak leads are written.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrent website checks
maxConcurrency.description: Conservative default limits load on public business sites.

confirmationChecks.title: Matching checks required
confirmationChecks.description: An issue is emitted only when all checks return the same objective failure.

confirmationDelayMs.title: Delay between confirmations (ms)
confirmationDelayMs.description: Delay between matching checks of the same failed URL.

onlyWithPublicContact.title: Require public email or phone
onlyWithPublicContact.description: When enabled, suppress results without an explicit public business email or phone number.

maxCriticalLinksPerSite.title: Maximum critical links per site
maxCriticalLinksPerSite.description: Caps booking/contact links checked on each website.
